title: When Krishna himself stormed Narakasura's fortress
hooks: Ek raakshas jise koi purush nahi maar sakta... toh phir kaun maarega?
Krishna ne ek baar apna chakra ghuma diya - poora durg hil gaya
16000 raaniyan bandi theen. Unka mukti kaun dilayega?
hook_why: Instant curiosity gap: impossible boon + who breaks it. Second person pulls viewer in.
metaphor: Outer fortress = inner ego. One clean strike frees both.

cast.Krishna: Calm divine figure, peacock feather, blue skin, gold silk, soft halo, painterly Indian epic style
cast.Narakasura: Hulking demon king, dark ornate armor, red glowing eyes, arrogant smirk, same painterly style

scenes.vo: Listen - there was a demon named Narakasura. Boon: no man could kill him.
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, massive dark fortress gates glowing with red runes, stormy sky, no text

scenes.vo: He shook all three worlds. Imprisoned 16,000 queens.
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, vast dungeon hall, countless women in royal clothes, dim torchlight, no text

scenes.vo: Everyone gave up. Then Krishna himself arrived. No army, no noise - just him.
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, single blue figure walking toward glowing fortress gates, wind in peacock feather, no text

scenes.vo: The walls were sealed with mantras. Krishna blew his conch - even the stones trembled.
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, conch shell glowing gold, sound waves cracking stone walls, divine light, no text

scenes.vo: Narakasura laughed: 'Remember the boon? No man can kill me.'
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, demon king on obsidian throne pointing at Krishna, red aura, arrogant, no text

scenes.vo: Krishna smiled. Spun the Sudarshan Chakra on his finger - light like the sun.
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, close-up: spinning golden disc on fingertip, blinding light cutting darkness, no text

scenes.vo: One strike. Mantra protection broke like butter. Boon failed - because Krishna wasn't a mere man, he was God.
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, golden disc slicing through red shield, demon armor cracking, light winning, no text

scenes.vo: Narakasura fell. All locks broke. Queens freed - sent home with full dignity.
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, palace gates opening, women walking out in morning light, Krishna blessing, no text

scenes.vo: This story is from the Bhagavata Purana. But the real question now: do you have a fortress inside?
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, quiet temple courtyard at twilight, diyas flickering, one empty throne, no text

scenes.vo: Break that fortress of ego. New story tomorrow. Follow @aagesuno.
scenes.prompt: Painterly Indian epic style, golden lotus on dark water, single ripple, soft glow, no text

caption:
When Krishna defeated Narakasura, it wasn't just a demon dying - an empire of ego fell. Bhagavata Purana, Book 10. When will your inner fortress fall? #mythology #krishna #narakasura #ego #aagesuno
